title: 殿下の華麗なるたしなみ

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: For today's Japanese cultural workshop, we'll be learning flower arrangement. Let's get started, shall we? ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Okay! ♪ I've been looking forward to this forever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I decide to join Fine Motion as she learns about Japanese culture.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The art of Japanese flower arrangement focuses on granting new life to flowers. To do so, you must approach them with a calm heart and truly converse with them.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: First, select a flower to serve as the centerpiece. I've prepared several in advance, so pick one that's to your liking.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… Oh, I think I'll choose that cherry blossom. It's a flower with special meaning to me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: When I was still just considering studying abroad, I saw a photo of cherry blossoms in full bloom. It left me quite struck by the beauty of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I see… Very interesting. Cherry blossoms are indeed one of many flowers that represents this country.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And for your flower arrangement to be truly spectacular, selecting a flower you have a special attachment to is a splendid idea.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Now that I've chosen my flower, the next step is… to converse with it, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: How can I draw out your beauty? It was truly love at first sight when I saw the contrast of your white petals against the blue sky…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And it was so moving when I saw you with my own eyes in Japan! Oh, the amount of times I walked beneath you to be showered in your falling petals!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it looks like you're on the way to creating a wonderful piece. ♪ The variety in height of your cuttings is perfectly balanced, and there's nothing wanting in your assortment either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I continue working on my own piece, I have to imagine that her movements, charming in their subtlety, will result in a delicate arrangement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I finally lay eyes on her piece, I find that it is indeed focused and dignified…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But it also invokes a sense of mighty strength, like that of a sturdy boulder!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: In essence, this is what resides in Fine's heart—her true form.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, this is a little embarrassing. It's like you can see right through me!
choice_data_list: This is what's in her heart…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm taken aback by my impression of Fine Motion's arrangement. Far from being delicate, it exudes a firm strength. I move closer to get a better look, when…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Careful!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snatch!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Are you okay? You're not hurt, are you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems I tripped over the table leg, but Fine Motion caught me in her arms right before I fell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I recover from the shock, I glance around to get my bearings. But when I look at Fine Motion, I see something behind her.
choice_data_list: (It's a cliff! One that stands tall, firm, and reliable!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, my apologies. Even if it was by reflex, I should not have grabbed you without permission. Still, I'm glad you're not hurt!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've always seen Fine Motion as being sweet and innocent, but after seeing her flower arrangement, she feels tremendously strong and dependable.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Striding forward without hesitation, an unshakable center of balance, ample flexibility… always on guard.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Your body control just now was incredible. Do you have some kind of experience in martial arts, Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm, I did some fencing in the past. But only a little.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I see! That steadfast posture and unwavering spirit… I could even see it in the way you arranged your flowers.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! I'm honored, but I think you're giving me too much credit. Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Um, hello? Trainer? Are you there?
choice_data_list: Your strength took my breath away…
I was just thinking about how much we learned today.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh my. I really am so sorry! I had no idea I startled you that much!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I don't think you need to apologize. That sounds like admiration.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Sooo… basically, you thought I was cool?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, It's not so bad having you think of me that way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I was able to catch a glimpse at Fine Motion's charm today—equal parts loveliness and strength.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It was certainly a fruitful experience!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hey, would you like to join me again next time? I'm sure there'll be so much more to learn.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Then, what shall we cover next time? If you'll both be joining, something easy to do in pairs is probably best.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I suggest judo!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'll never forget the day I learned the true essence of judo—as an art of gaining victory by yielding to strength! I've always wanted to learn more!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And if you're with me, we can practice our techniques and even have a bout! What do you think?
choice_data_list: You want to practice techniques… on each other?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah, I guess you have a point. That might be beyond the scope of simple study. It may be best to save that for another time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I was scared there for a second… That aside, Fine Motion's eyes are shining with curiosity. I'm deeply impressed by her thirst for knowledge.
